background: NORD/LB is the Landesbank of Lower Saxony and Saxony-Anhalt, owned by the two states and the regional savings banks, a corporate, energy and real-estate lender that was recapitalised after shipping losses and also acts as central bank for its savings banks.
synthesis: Ratings are AA- from Fitch after the upgrade on 12 May 2026 and Aa2 from Moody's, both stable, resting on state ownership and the savings-bank protection scheme. Capital is strong against EU and Nordic peers, with CET1 of 17.8% in the top quarter against the peer median and leverage of 6.0% above 5.5%, and both up since 30 Jun 2024, CET1 by 2.4 points and leverage by 0.4 points. Liquidity is mixed: LCR of 153% is above the peer median and up 18 points since 30 Jun 2025, while NSFR of 108% is in the bottom quarter against 124% and down 5 points. The figures run to 31 Mar 2026. Nothing has been flagged in the last 90 days.
